  • Dānapāramī 5 The Perfection of Giving (5th)

Mahāgovindacariya Mahāgovinda’s Conduct

“Punāparaṁ yadā homi, “Then again when I was sattarājapurohito; high priest for seven kings, Pūjito naradevehi, I was venerated by the gods among men mahāgovindabrāhmaṇo. as the brahmin Mahāgovinda.

Tadāhaṁ sattarajjesu, Then in all seven kingdoms Yaṁ me āsi upāyanaṁ; what I received as tribute Tena demi mahādānaṁ, I used to give a great gift Akkhobbhaṁ sāgarūpamaṁ. unwavering as the ocean.

Na me dessaṁ dhanaṁ dhaññaṁ, It was not because I disliked riches or grain, Napi natthi nicayo mayi; or because I had a store set aside, Sabbaññutaṁ piyaṁ mayhaṁ, but because omniscience is precious to me, Tasmā demi varaṁ dhanan”ti. that is why I gave such fine riches.”

Mahāgovindacariyaṁ pañcamaṁ.
